text_markup: The Runner plays {card:Account Siphon} while {card:Ash 2X3ZB9CY} is installed in the root of HQ, and the run is successful. The Runner can wait until after the trace from {card:Ash 2X3ZB9CY} completes before deciding to access cards normally or force the Corp to lose credits.
